verdict.rationale: Morph has a dedicated caching docs page stating that prefix caching is on by default for every open-source model, with no configuration and no cache-write surcharge. That directly covers repeated-context caching for an ML engineer. Compact and Standby are separate cost features and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented cache-hit pricing or latency figures, coverage beyond open-source models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
